column1: Approved Employment-Based Petitions Awaiting Visa Availability
By Preference Category and Country of Birth
1) The report reflects the most up-to-date estimate available at the time the database is queried.
2) Counts may differ from those reported in previous periods due to system updates and post-adjudicative outcomes.
3) The counts of approved petitions represent only primary beneficiaries. Dependents are not included.
4) For a complete list of USCIS forms and descriptions, visit uscis.gov/forms.
5) For details on Green Card Eligibility Categories see https://www.uscis.gov/greencard/eligibility-categories.

6) The priority date is based on September 2021 Visa Bulletin Final Action Dates chart
https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/legal/visa-law0/visa-bulletin.html.
